scripts.title: ESP AIM
scripts.features:
This script is a high-performance tool designed for tactical gameplay. It features a sophisticated visualization engine and a high-precision aimbot specifically tuned for realistic weapon mechanics where bullets originate from the barrel rather than the camera center.

🛠 Key Features
Dynamic Player ESP: Renders clean 2D boxes and full skeletal overlays. Visuals automatically scale based on the target's distance to maintain screen clarity.

FPV Drone Tracker: A specialized scanner that detects all active "FPVDrone" entities in the workspace, highlighting them with a high-priority red overlay.

Precision Aimbot (Head-Only): Hard-locks onto the enemy's head. It includes built-in logic to ignore the local player and teammates.

Muzzle Correction Technology: Unlike standard aimbots, this system calculates the screen offset of your weapon's muzzle (Barrel or Bolt). It aligns the actual bore of the gun with the target's head, compensating for weapon sway and off-center hip-fire positions.

Intelligent Wall Check: Uses raycasting to ensure the aimbot only engages targets that are physically visible, making the cheat look more natural and preventing snaps through solid objects.

Zero-Ghosting Cleanup: Features a robust memory management system. When a target dies or a drone is destroyed, all associated drawings are physically removed from memory, preventing "frozen" ESP boxes from cluttering your screen.
